feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 August 2026 9:59pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 19 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Small-scale area of low pressure in the Irish Sea as various fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, veering north or northeast 3 to 5 overnight and occasionally 6 in places tomorrow morning. Backing north or northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon and occasionally 6 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, heavy at times, becoming isolated tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 3 or 4, occasionally 5 at first, then increasing more generally 5 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, mainly becoming confined to the south.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
